---
title: Seed generators
description: Every generator a Dataset can declare to fill itself with realistic rows.
---

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask generator-docs`; do not edit. -->

A Dataset may declare `[datasets.generator]` with a row count and a field list instead of `seed` or `seed_template` (at most one source). Each field names a generator with `kind` and its options. With the Server's `fake_seed` set, the same rows are produced on every start.

## Generators

| Kind | Description |
|---|---|
| `int` | Integer in `min`..=`max` (default 0..=1000), optional `step` |
| `float` | Float in `min`..=`max` (default 0..1) rounded to `precision` decimals (default 2) |
| `bool` | Boolean, true with `probability` (default 0.5) |
| `uuid` | UUID v4 string |
| `ulid` | ULID string |
| `sequence` | Row index based number: `start` (default 1) plus `step` (default 1) per row |
| `regex` | String matching `pattern` |
| `one_of` | One of `values`, optionally picked by `weights` |
| `string` | Random string of `length` (default 8) from `charset` (default alphanumeric) |
| `lorem` | `words` (default 5) lorem ipsum words |
| `fake` | Any `fake` kind named by `fake`, e.g. `internet.email` |
| `datetime` | RFC 3339 / `format` timestamp between `min` and `max` (RFC 3339, default last 365 days; one bound alone spans 365 days from it) |
| `date` | Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) between `min` and `max` |
| `const` | The fixed `value` |
| `ref` | Key (`field`, default `id`) of a row in another Dataset of the same Server (`dataset`) |
| `null_or` | `inner` generator, or null with `null_probability` (default 0.5) |
| `template` | Tera expression `expr`; earlier fields of the row are in `row` |
| `object` | Nested object built from `fields` |
| `array` | Array of `min`..=`max` (default 1..=3) items from `item` |
